trigger: U67's verifier found a Swift Testing macro-expansion warning that every '0 Swift warnings' check since merge-d had missed (DECISIONS #37).
lesson: Swift compiler warnings raised inside a macro expansion print as 'macro expansion #expect:L:C: warning:', not '<file>.swift:L:C: warning:', so a grep on the file pattern under-counts; and an incremental build prints warnings only for files it recompiles.
how_to_apply: Count warnings with a pattern that also matches '^macro expansion …:N:N: warning:' and prove any zero-warning claim with a FRESH derived-data build (or after touching the files).
